SERVICE_HEADLINE: Looking like yourself, only better rested
TAGLINE: A small, nurse-led practice where the person assessing your face is the person treating it. We will tell you when a treatment is not worth your money.
SERVICES_INTRO: We keep the menu deliberately short. Everything here is something we do often enough to do exceptionally well.
SERVICE_1_BODY: Assessed in movement, not at rest, so you keep your expressions. We start conservative and refine at your two-week review.
SERVICE_2_BODY: Structural work on cheeks, chin and jawline. We map the whole face first rather than filling whichever line you noticed this morning.
SERVICE_3_BODY: Microneedling, peels and a prescription routine that actually fits your week. Results build over months, and we will say so upfront.
PRACTITIONER_BIO: Eleven years injecting, the last six in her own practice. Trained in advanced facial anatomy, and teaches injection technique to other nurses twice a year. Sees every consultation personally.
WHY_INTRO: There are a dozen places within twenty minutes that will sell you the same syringe. Here is what is different about buying it here.
WHY_1_TITLE: You see the same face every visit
WHY_1_BODY: Marta does every consultation and every treatment. No rotating roster, no handing you to whoever is free.
WHY_2_BODY: If a treatment will not get you where you want to go, we say so and explain what would. Roughly one consultation in six leaves without booking.
WHY_3_BODY: Every injectable appointment includes a follow-up to assess and adjust. It is built into the price, not sold back to you.
REVIEW_1_TEXT: I came in asking for filler and left with a skincare plan and no appointment. Six months later she finally agreed I was ready. That is why I trust her.
REVIEW_2_TEXT: Third practice I have tried locally and the first where I did not feel upsold. She talked me out of the more expensive option.
REVIEW_3_TEXT: Subtle, even, and nobody has asked what I had done. They just keep asking whether I have been on holiday.
CONTACT_INTRO: Consultations are 30 minutes, unhurried, and there is no obligation to book anything on the day.
